verdict: Lead volume dropped sharply; overdue deliverables are the priority this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 7 leads at an average cost per lead of $242.73 — and in the most recent 7 days, lead volume fell 80% against the prior 7 days while cost per lead spiked 215%. That collapse traces directly to a 59% pullback in Google Ads spend over the same 7-day stretch, which cut the channel that had been driving the majority of your conversions. Separately, four agreed deliverables — the booking bot, Review Boost campaign, financing page, and Homer Glen branch — remain undelivered past their August 31 due date, and confirming an intake owner (also overdue) is the gate that must open before any spend scale-up can happen. Those items are being resolved now so that the October heating campaign launch, and the budget increase tied to it, can proceed on schedule.
